request: Owner asked to enlarge the title frame around the existing wording in Chinese and English, not reduce global typography.

entries.prompt:

Exact text: "尸潮防线", exactly once, all letters/glyphs correct, single line, no additional words. Keep the lettering style cyan-left to lavender-right flat bold slightly slanted lettering; dark gunmetal chamfered plaque, continuous cyan-left and purple-right conduit. Do not redesign or substitute a generic logo.
CRITICAL CHANGE: ENLARGE THE FRAME'S INNER FACE VERTICALLY around the text. The lettering retains its original proportion relative to the whole emblem WIDTH, about 72–76% wide; do not reduce the lettering to fix the fit. Move the TOP rail up and BOTTOM rail down, extending the side walls. Provide a broad, unbroken dark inner-face gap above AND below the ENTIRE visible letter silhouettes, each at least 30% of the letter height. Optical centering is critical: do not place the text low. The bottommost stroke must have as much clear space below it as the topmost stroke has above it. Decorative top/bottom crests are moved OUTWARD with their rails, never into the letter area. Side margins are balanced. This must look like an enlarged title plaque with intentional breathing room, not a text-stuffed thin button.
Same straight-on centered view, dimensional polished/worn metal detail, restrained glow from the original palette, dark center, same thin rail thickness. Keep ornaments consistent with reference. No new symbols, no added motif, no new colors, no stretch/distortion of glyphs. Maintain mobile game rendered asset quality.
Output one isolated horizontal logo on a REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background, 1536x1024 canvas. At least 8% transparent margins around all artwork. No scene, no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard painted in, no green spill, no fog outside the silhouette, no hard canvas crop, no watermark. Prioritize clearly EQUAL generous top and bottom text-to-frame gaps.
